lessons.title: Welcome Back — Understanding Typography
lessons.content:
Welcome back.

Today, we will be focusing on one of the most important elements of graphic design: typography.

Typography is more than choosing a font that looks attractive. It involves how text is selected, arranged, and presented to communicate information effectively. The way you use typography can influence the readability, personality, mood, and overall appearance of your design.

Whether you are creating social media graphics, posters, advertisements, brand materials, or other visual content, understanding typography will help you make better design decisions.

In today's lesson, you will explore the fundamentals of typography, the differences between fonts and typefaces, different font categories, font personality, and how to choose appropriate fonts for different purposes.

You will also learn about typography hierarchy and how it helps organize information within a design.

lessons.title: What You'll Learn Today
lessons.content:
TODAY, YOU WILL LEARN ABOUT:

- What Typography Is
- Font vs. Typeface
- Different Font Categories
- Font Personality
- Choosing Fonts for Different Purposes
- Typography Hierarchy

lessons.title: Part 1 — Understanding Typography
lessons.content:
Typography plays an important role in how written information is communicated through design.

In this section, you will explore what typography means and understand the difference between a font and a typeface.

You will also be introduced to different font categories, including serif, sans serif, display, script, and decorative fonts, and begin to understand how their visual characteristics can influence the appearance and personality of a design.

Additionally, you will explore how to select fonts based on the purpose of a design, its intended audience, and the kind of message you want to communicate.

A BRIEF OVERVIEW

The explanation above is only a summary of the topic. You are required to watch the full lesson below to develop a deeper understanding of typography and how it is used in graphic design.

lessons.title: Typography Hierarchy
lessons.content:
When a design contains multiple pieces of text, the viewer needs to understand which information deserves attention first.

Typography hierarchy helps establish the order in which text is noticed and read. It allows designers to distinguish important information from supporting details and organize written content in a way that is easier to understand.

WATCH HERE

Typography Hierarchy

lessons.title: Today's Goal
lessons.content:
Today's goal is to understand how typography contributes to effective visual communication.

By the end of today's lessons, you should have a clearer understanding of typography, different font categories, font personality, font selection, and the role of hierarchy in organizing text.

Remember, choosing a font is not simply about picking something that looks good. It is about choosing and arranging text in a way that supports the purpose of your design.

As you progress through the course, you will learn how to apply these concepts to create designs that are clearer, more readable, and more visually effective.

lessons.title: Tuesday — Creating Powerful Typography
lessons.content:
Welcome back.

In our previous lesson, you were introduced to typography, different font categories, font personality, and typography hierarchy. Today, we will build on that foundation and explore how to use typography more intentionally to create visually compelling designs.

Typography can make a design stand out, guide the viewer's attention, and communicate a message effectively. However, achieving this requires more than selecting an attractive font. You also need to understand how to combine fonts, control spacing, create contrast, position text, and maintain readability.

In today's lesson, you will learn how to make typography a stronger part of your designs. You will also explore how to apply these concepts using the software available on your chosen design track.

If you are learning Smartphone Graphic Design, you will work with PixelLab. If you are learning PC Graphic Design, you will work with Adobe Photoshop.

The goal is to help you understand not just how to add text to a design, but how to make that text communicate effectively.

lessons.title: What You'll Learn Today — Creating Powerful Typography
lessons.content:
TODAY, YOU WILL EXPLORE:

- Creating Powerful Typography
- Font Pairing
- Headline Fonts vs. Body Fonts
- Font Size, Weight, Letter Spacing, and Line Spacing
- Text Alignment and Hierarchy
- Text Contrast and Emphasis
- Text Placement
- Common Typography Mistakes
- Making Text Readable on Mobile Screens

You will then apply these concepts using the software for your chosen track.

lessons.title: Part 1 — Creating Powerful Typography
lessons.content:
Typography can influence how a design looks, how information is understood, and what the viewer notices first.

In this lesson, you will explore how to combine fonts, adjust text properties, establish hierarchy, create emphasis, and position text effectively within a design.

You will also learn why readability matters, particularly when designing for mobile screens, where text must remain clear and easy to understand despite limited space.

The lesson will help you understand how to make typography more intentional rather than simply adding text and hoping it looks good.

A BRIEF OVERVIEW

The explanation above is only a summary of the topic. Watch the full lesson below to understand the techniques being taught and how they can be applied when creating designs.

In this lesson, you will explore PixelLab's text controls and learn how to work with font selection, text positioning, spacing, strokes, shadows, and other text effects.

You will begin to understand how these tools can help you control the appearance of text and apply the typography techniques discussed in the previous lesson.

lessons.title: Part 3 — PC Track: Photoshop Typography

PART 3 — PC GRAPHIC DESIGN TRACK: PHOTOSHOP TYPOGRAPHY

If you are following the PC Graphic Design Track, this section introduces you to the typography tools and controls available in Adobe Photoshop.

You will explore the tools used to manage text appearance, formatting, alignment, spacing, and positioning. You will also be introduced to text effects and layer styles that can help you customize the appearance of text within your designs.

The goal is to help you become familiar with Photoshop's typography workspace and understand how to use its tools when working on design projects.

lessons.title: Tuesday's Goal
lessons.content:
Today's goal is to move from understanding typography to using it intentionally in your designs.

By the end of today's lessons, you should have a clearer understanding of how to combine fonts, organize text, create emphasis, control spacing, improve readability, and position typography effectively.

You should also begin to understand how these decisions can be implemented using PixelLab or Photoshop, depending on your chosen track.

Remember, powerful typography is not simply about making text attractive. It is about making text work for the design.

Pay attention to how text interacts with other visual elements and how small adjustments can influence the clarity, balance, and overall appearance of a composition.
